def.brief: Answers the carried Codex newbie finding of run-20261030-063525-2d81/environment, an 'unclear': 'Following this instruction did not provide a way to verify the environment adoption requested by the goal.' It quoted README 'Release and adoption': 'reconcile the consuming project's declared environment and lock if managed, and start a new host session to apply the installation.' That Codex answer stays as recorded. Documentation only: insert sentences after that one and change no adopted line. They say that reconciliation, and checking that the environment is compatible (worker hosts, reporters, coherence, plugin fingerprints), belongs to the consuming project's environment manager and its workflow. jokbo is not that manager: it reads and indexes the sources the project declares (documents, history, and the reads in its lock or hunsu.json) and says how current each is; it cannot tell whether an environment matches its lock. Keep the README standalone and short: name no other product's CLI or workflow, and add no runtime dependency. VERIFIER: read the README diff against the source, not only this packet. In jokbo.py: declared_reads and manifest_and_lock (around lines 175-209; the only lock fields read are 'reads' and 'record-paths'); run_read and overlay (around lines 250-283: a declared read is run and its text quoted, not judged); the CLI commands in main (file, since, find, index, map, note: none verifies an environment). Also confirm jokbo.py and hooks/ import no sibling plugin.
checks: import sys; s = open('README.md').read(); sec = ' '.join(s[s.index('### Release and adoption'):s.index('## Self-check')].split()); need = ['environment manager', 'jokbo is not that manager', 'worker hosts', 'reporters', 'coherence', 'plugin fingerprints', 'reads and indexes', 'cannot tell whether an environment matches its lock']; miss = [x for x in need if x not in sec]; other = [x for x in ('hunsu.py', 'chongdae.py', 'dwitbuk.py', 'mangsang.py', 'hacheong', 'hunsu check', 'hunsu lock', 'chongdae run') if x in sec]; print('boundary note in Release and adoption; missing phrases:', miss, '| other products CLI named:', other); sys.exit(1 if miss or other else 0)

import glob, re, subprocess, sys; src = {f: open(f).read() for f in ['jokbo.py'] + sorted(glob.glob('hooks/*.py'))}; imp = [f for f, s in src.items() if re.search(r'^\s*(import|from)\s+(hunsu|chongdae|dwitbuk|mangsang|hacheong)\b', s, re.M)]; fields = sorted(set(m for s in src.values() for m in re.findall(r'lock\.get\("([\w-]+)"\)', s))); h = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'jokbo.py', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; cmds = re.search(r'\{([\w,]+)\}', h).group(1).split(','); ok = not imp and fields == ['reads', 'record-paths'] and cmds == ['file', 'since', 'find', 'index', 'map', 'note']; print('sibling plugin imports:', imp, '| lock fields jokbo reads:', fields, '| commands (none verifies an environment):', cmds); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re, subprocess, sys; d = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '-U0', 'e0aa826', '--', '.', ':(exclude).chongdae', ':(exclude)reviews'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; files = re.findall(r'^\+\+\+ b/(.+)$', d, re.M); removed = [l for l in d.split(chr(10)) if l.startswith('-') and not l.startswith('---')]; new = open('README.md').read().split(chr(10)); lo = new.index('### Release and adoption') + 1; hi = new.index('## Self-check') + 1; hunks = [(int(a), int(b) if b else 1) for a, b in re.findall(r'^@@ -\S+ \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@', d, re.M)]; ok = files == ['README.md'] and bool(hunks) and not removed and all(lo <= a and a + max(n, 1) - 1 < hi for a, n in hunks); print('changed since e0aa826:', files, '| hunks:', hunks, '| inside Release and adoption lines', lo, '-', hi - 1, '| adopted lines removed or rewritten:', len(removed), ':', ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import os, re, sys; fence = lambda s: re.sub(r'(?ms)^\`\`\`.*?^\`\`\`', '', s); slug = lambda h: re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.strip().lower()).replace(' ', '-'); heads = lambda f: {slug(m) for m in re.findall(r'^#+ +(.+?) *$', fence(open(f).read()), re.M)}; links = [(f, l) for f in ('README.md', 'AGENTS.md') for l in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)\s]+)\)', fence(open(f).read())) if not l.startswith(('http://', 'https://', 'mailto:'))]; tgt = lambda f, l: os.path.join(os.path.dirname(f), l.partition('#')[0]) if l.partition('#')[0] else f; bad = [f + ' -> ' + l for f, l in links if not os.path.exists(tgt(f, l)) or (l.partition('#')[2] and l.partition('#')[2] not in heads(tgt(f, l)))]; imp = open('CLAUDE.md').read() == '@AGENTS.md\n'; print('relative links checked:', len(links), '| broken:', bad, '| CLAUDE.md is only the AGENTS.md import:', imp); sys.exit(0 if links and not bad and imp else 1)

import subprocess, sys; a = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', 'e0aa826', '--', 'README.md'], capture_output=True, text=True); print('git diff --check README.md exit', a.returncode, a.stdout[:200]); sys.exit(a.returncode)
